footnote_text: The Reporting Person was granted 364,964 restricted stock units ("RSUs"), which each represent a contingent right to receive one ordinary share of Similarweb Ltd (the "Company"). 25% of the RSUs vest on November 15, 2027, and the remaining 75% of the RSUs vest in 12 equal quarterly installments thereafter, with the final vesting date on November 15, 2030, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service to the Company or its subsidiaries through each vesting date.
